# Habl Allah Quranic Academy (أكاديمية حبل الله القرآنية)

> An integrated online Quranic learning platform for adults and children, connecting students with Ijazah-certified teachers for live one-on-one sessions, structured recorded courses, Quranic competitions, and internationally recognized certificates.

## Overview

Habl Allah Quranic Academy (أكاديمية حبل الله القرآنية) operates two dedicated learning portals:

- **Habl Allah Platform (منصة حبل الله):** Quran memorization (Hifz), recitation, and Tajweed for adults and children with certified male and female teachers, live one-on-one sessions, structured courses, periodic competitions, and progress tracking.
- **Usus Habl Allah Platform (منصة أسس حبل الله):** Interactive foundational Islamic education for children covering simplified Fiqh, Aqeedah, Seerah, and Quranic games.

## Supported Languages

The website is available in three languages:
- **Arabic (العربية — default):** Root paths (`/`, `/quran`, ...)
- **English:** Prefixed with `/en` (`/en`, `/en/quran`, ...)
- **Turkish (Türkçe):** Prefixed with `/tr` (`/tr`, `/tr/quran`, ...)
